audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven level-chart rows contradict this page's own whys text. win[0] says Heimerdinger while whys[0] calls it 'a true coin-flip'; win[2] and win[3] say Tahm Kench while whys[2] and whys[3] describe you out-taxing his CS and a nest he cannot walk into; win[4] says Heimerdinger while whys[4] ends 'it nets even'; win[5] says Tahm Kench while whys[5] ends 'neither side pulls ahead'.
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Skill, Tahm Kench — and it agrees with the whys text on every single row. The sides layer is the outlier, not the prose.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 flipped in both layers as one paired atomic group, to the packet chart the prose already described. Ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', and it is right — not one number appears in the spikes, phases or cooldown block.
audit.why: The numbers that decide this lane are Tongue Lash at 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s and 900 range, Abyssal Dive at 21/20/19/18/17s, Thick Skin on a 3s active, and on your side CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade at a flat 11s with UPGRADE!!! at 100/85/70s. The real sequencing rule is not a cooldown at all: it is the An Acquired Taste stack count, because at three stacks the next Tongue Lash stuns and Devour becomes available.
audit.corrected: Tongue Lash's 7s, Abyssal Dive's 21s and the flat-11s grenade written in, and every 'track Tongue Lash' instruction re-keyed to tracking the stack count — the thing that actually gates his damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three systematic errors. (a) 'Abyssal Voyage' is described as a roaming/global ultimate in whys[4], whys[6], spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, late and wants.you[2]. (b) 'CH-3X center-stun' / 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' appears four times. (c) 'grey-health passive' is used six times, and spikes[1] calls Tongue Lash a 'root-stun'.
audit.why: Abyssal Voyage does not exist on live Tahm Kench — his W is Abyssal Dive (a 21s knock-up reposition, 1000 range) and his R is Devour, which eats one champion for a few seconds. There is no roam, no global, no map-flank. The page is telling a player to fear an ability that was removed. Heimerdinger's stun is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11s flat, and Riot's text stuns only 'anyone directly hit'. The grey health belongs to Thick Skin (E) — 'stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat; active: convert all stored damage into a temporary shield' — while the passive An Acquired Taste is the stack mechanic. And Tongue Lash stuns; nothing in his kit roots.
audit.corrected: Every Abyssal Voyage roam claim replaced with what Devour and Abyssal Dive actually do; CH-3X replaced with CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade; grey health attributed to Thick Skin; the root removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing tells you that poking him is partly self-defeating.
audit.why: Thick Skin stores a percent of everything you land and converts it to a shield on demand, so a long unpunished beam-and-rocket war banks his defence. The trade rule that follows is to poke in bursts that force the shield out, then commit — not to chip endlessly. Flagged in missingInteractions as 'shield-absorbs-burst' and 'needs-antiheal'.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[5], early and breakdown.late, with anti-heal justified rather than asserted.

audit.why: report[8] already puts Oblivion Orb / Executioner's early. That is correct here and now has a stated reason: Tongue Lash heals him on champion hit and Thick Skin heals him out of combat, so two separate sustain sources feed off your poke pattern.

notes: The biggest defect here is an ability that no longer exists. 'Abyssal Voyage' is described as a roaming/global ultimate in whys[4], whys[6], spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, late and wants.you[2] — six places telling a player to fear a map-flank Tahm Kench cannot do. Live W is Abyssal Dive (21s at rank 1, a knock-up reposition) and live R is Devour, which eats one champion for a few seconds and is gated behind three An Acquired Taste stacks. The mirror recorded the same defect and counted 62 occurrences in champ-data/content/tahmkench.js and 84 across 23 files in champ-data/ — this is champion-wide, not matchup-local, and worth a dedicated sweep. Second: 'CH-3X center-stun' / 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' four times; Heimerdinger's stun is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11s flat, stunning only a direct hit. Third: 'grey-health passive' six times — the grey health is Thick Skin (E), the passive is An Acquired Taste, and conflating them hides the real trading rule, which is now stated: Thick Skin banks a percent of your poke and converts it to a shield, so endless chip funds his defence. Also removed 'root-stun' (Tongue Lash stuns; nothing in his kit roots) and the winCon claim that you 'out-scale' him, which is backwards — whys[6] and the packet both have him winning 2+ items. LEVEL CHART realigned as a paired atomic group on rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5: the packet chart matched this page's own whys text on every row, and the sides layer matched neither.
